apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: hello-world
spec:
  containers:
  - name: hello
    image: busybox:latest
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "Hello, World!"']
  restartPolicy: Never
kubectl get pods -n production -l app=typing-api -o wide

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: typing-service
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: typing-api
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: typing-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: typing-api

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: typing-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: typing-api
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 75

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: app-ingress
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
spec:
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - typing.local
    secretName: app-tls-cert
  rules:
  - host: typing.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: typing-service
            port:
              number: 80

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: typing-engine
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: typing-engine
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: typing-engine
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: typing-engine:v2.0
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "512Mi"
          requests:
            cpu: "100m"
            memory: "128Mi"
source: Kubernetes: Production Deployment with Resource Limits

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-allow-db
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres-db
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: typing-api
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-secrets
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DATABASE_URL: "postgres://user:password@db:5432/app"
  API_KEY: "prod_live_secret_key_value"
source: Kubernetes: Opaque secret with stringData declaration
